purpose: Research-only contract audit of the November 3 first-light Montrose observations; both in-window records are narrow visible-scope candidates, collapse to one independent candidate morning, and neither becomes a whole-cell, whole-morning, or clean training negative.

source_receipt.dawn_horizon_register_basis: J01 / J11 silent Dawn receipt — November 3, 2026
source_receipt.assessment_basis: validated upstream three-frame vision; no independent pixel or biological review
source_receipt.later_snapshot_excluded_from_labeling: Repository state after the audited dawn window was not used to backfill predictors or labels.

method: Require an in-window immutable observation record, fresh/healthy primary contact camera, at least moderate visibility and detectability, and no visual event evidence. Restrict candidate negative evidence to visible 437 Montrose waterline/beach segments. Collapse records by local date and independent site group. Preserve public/social effort, whole-morning outcome, and unresolved environmental matching dimensions as UNKNOWN. Do not infer a Point Clear control from marina/Bay views.
blockers_before_tier_a_or_training_use: Independent biological review or observation channel sufficient to label the visible interval
Known same-window public/social or human observation effort, or an explicit admissible missingness rule
Defensible whole-window coverage rather than two first-light samples
Matched confirmed-event window with comparable season, clock time, tide/current context, and observation availability
Accepted nearshore observed-current or transport phase; no current official tide prediction was admitted and model guidance is insufficient
Temporal-availability audit for every contextual feature
rationale: Both in-window Montrose shoreline records satisfy the camera-specific visible-scope candidate contract and collapse to one independent morning. They do not establish a whole-morning or full-cell non-event, lack an independent biological label and same-window public/social effort, and do not unlock oxygen-only, transport-only, or combined held-out Jubilee evaluation.
guardrails: No-report silence is never a negative.
Point Clear marina/Bay views do not establish a close-shore control.
Regional/model proxies do not substitute for observed nearshore current or direct bottom oxygen.
No later snapshot was used to backfill dawn-available predictors.
No production probability, weight, threshold, cadence, camera, schedule, UNKNOWN rule, or 9 PM gate changes.
